subject: Invoice format & delivery workflow — BU split / bilingual
messages:
From: Lukas Bauer <l.bauer@brightcell.com>
To: neha_kapoor <neha_kapoor@redwood.com>
Cc: accounts-payable@brightcell.com
Date: Fri, 03 Feb 2028 08:22:00 +0100
Subject: Invoice delivery and format - a few onboarding questions

Hi Neha,

Thanks for taking this — we're excited to move BrightCell onto Redwood. A few requirements from AP and tax to make sure we match our ERP: 

- We need a single consolidated monthly invoice but with line-item splits per business unit (BU code) so our AP can allocate to multiple GLs.
- Invoices must be bilingual (English + German). German should appear first where a language choice is required.
- We require machine-readable UBL/XML (or another standard XML) plus a human-readable PDF copy.
- For remittance, each invoice line may carry a PO number and a remittance address: sometimes the billing contact and remit-to differ by BU.
- VAT evidence: include the VAT ID for the selling entity on the invoice and a separate field for the buyer VAT (we will indicate when reverse charge applies).
- Preferred delivery: portal push with XML upload is preferred. If the portal cannot deliver the XML, we can accept nightly SFTP pickup of UBL files.

Could you send a sample UBL and the onboarding form that we need to sign? Also confirm whether Redwood can deliver a daily CSV of transaction-level lines (we'd like to ingest that into our AP).

We aim to go live the first week of March — is that doable?

Thanks,
Lukas Bauer
Head of Finance Operations
BrightCell Diagnostics

From: neha_kapoor <neha_kapoor@redwood.com>
To: Lukas Bauer <l.bauer@brightcell.com>
Cc: marissa_cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>, connor_obrien <connor_obrien@redwood.com>
Date: Fri, 03 Feb 2028 13:45:00 +01:00
Subject: Re: Invoice delivery and format - a few onboarding questions

Hi Lukas —

Great questions, and thanks for the clear list. Short answers up front, then next steps: 

1) Consolidated monthly invoice with BU-line splits: yes — Redwood can emit a single consolidated invoice per billing period while including line-level metadata for BU codes and PO numbers. We can map incoming PO fields to the invoice reference and to line-level metadata for your ERP.

2) Bilingual PDF + UBL/XML: supported. Our standard PDF template supports two-language layouts; we can place German first as requested. For the machine-readable file we support UBL (attached sample) or a custom XML schema if you prefer.

3) Delivery options: portal (preferred), SFTP, or webhook. Portal can host both the PDF and the UBL payload. If you prefer SFTP, we can drop nightly UBL files in your agreed path. We also support a daily transaction CSV webhook that posts to an authenticated endpoint.

4) VAT fields: we'll include seller VAT and a buyer VAT field and a flag for reverse-charge. We will not suppress VAT numbers from the PDF.

Next steps and timing:
- I'm attaching our onboarding form (BrightCell_onboarding_form.pdf) and a sample UBL (sample_invoice_ubl.xml). Please fill the onboarding form, include your AP contact, VAT numbers per entity, remit-to addresses and the BU -> GL mapping if you have one.
- Once returned, allow ~7 business days for config and a test invoice. If you can return the forms today, a go-live the first week of March is feasible.
- For SFTP we will provide a host/IPs to allowlist and a recommended filename pattern (we'll document that).

Requests for Connor / Marissa (cc'd): please confirm SFTP credential process and bilingual PDF template options.

Best,
Neha Kapoor
Payments & Revenue Ops
Redwood Inference

Attachments: BrightCell_onboarding_form.pdf, sample_invoice_ubl.xml

From: marissa_cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>

Date: Sun, 05 Feb 2028 09:10:00 +00:00
Subject: Re: Invoice delivery and format - a few onboarding questions

Looping Finance and Security in — few operational notes: 

- Security: we'll need BrightCell's SFTP jump host IPs for allowlisting and the SFTP account name if they want inbound pickup. If they prefer us to push files to their SFTP, Legal needs the host fingerprint and credentials exchange plan.
- Finance: we can expose per-invoice line metadata and the daily CSV webhook. Connor, can you enable the bilingual PDF template and confirm that the PO number can map to invoice.reference and to a custom invoice meta field?

Connor — can you also confirm whether the PDF places German first in our template set and whether we can include both language labels for tax fields (e.g., Umsatzsteuer / VAT)? If yes, we'll reply to Lukas with a short checklist for what we need.

Thanks —
Marissa
Head of Revenue Operations

Date: Mon, 07 Feb 2028 09:12:00 +01:00
Subject: Re: Invoice delivery and format - a few onboarding questions

Hi all — quick update from the payments team and confirmation for BrightCell's asks: 

- Bilingual PDF: yes, we can flip the language order so German appears first. The template will include dual-language labels for VAT fields ("Umsatzsteuer / VAT") and a bilingual footer.
- PO & BU mapping: we will map incoming PO numbers to invoice.reference and also emit a per-line custom field "bu_code" that matches your BU -> GL mapping. Please include a sample mapping CSV when you return the onboarding form.
- Delivery: portal-hosted UBL + PDF is preferred. We can also push nightly UBL to your SFTP (we require an allowlist and a single key-exchange step).
- Test invoice: we'll produce a non-financial test invoice the day before go-live for you to ingest.

Lukas — please confirm: 1) portal is acceptable, and 2) attach the PO sample and your per-entity VAT numbers and remit addresses. Once we have the completed onboarding form and PO sample we'll schedule the test invoice.

Connor O'Brien
Payments Engineering
Redwood Inference
